[USER] User inquired about the distinctions between modern dance and other dance styles such as ballet or salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern dance emphasizes the expressiveness and individuality of the dancer, often including improvisation and a focus on emotions and personal experiences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern dance breaks away from traditional ballet techniques and movements, including a more grounded approach and a greater emphasis on the use of the spine and torso.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Salsa is a partner dance style that originates from Latin America and typically involves energetic footwork and rhythmic hip movements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Salsa is characterized by a strong connection between the dancers and a heavy influence from Cuban and African music.  
[USER] User asked if modern dance is more free-form and less structured than ballet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, modern dance is considered to be more free-form and less structured than ballet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern dance emphasizes individual expression and experimentation, often incorporating improvisation and breaking away from traditional ballet techniques and movements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ballet is a highly formal and structured dance style with a defined vocabulary and technique that focuses on precise, graceful movements and positions.  
[USER] User expressed interest in the emotional aspect of modern dance compared to following a set of steps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern dance focuses on the emotions, beliefs, and personal experiences of the dancer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is less about following a predetermined set of steps and more about expressing oneself through a variety of movements, including those that are improvised in the moment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern dance is sometimes considered to be a form of self-exploration or therapy, allowing individuals to connect with their emotions and express themselves in a unique and personalized way.
